## Checklist

- [ ] No tool, argument or default was renamed/changed (only additive changes)

- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format --check .` pass

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under *Unreleased*
- [ ] No real email addresses, hostnames or credentials in code, tests or docs
